propositions: Prepare a committed helper script and verified off-repository backup bundle and manifest outside every Git worktree and directory, required by the reclaim window, without performing any remote ref deletion or push.

Enumerate live origin heads and tags at execution time via git ls-remote, collapse annotated-tag peeled lines onto canonical refs, and record exact direct and peeled OIDs with one ancestry relationship per commit tip.

Refuse partial or promisor clones, pre-existing refs/reclaim-backup/ refs, and any bundle or manifest paths inside the repository, Git directory, or registered worktrees; create parent directories only outside those boundaries and never overwrite artifacts.

Build and verify the bundle from explicit temporary refs for the old tip and requested pins, then restore into a throwaway repository and compare restored OIDs exactly; snapshot origin heads and tags before and after with no push, delete, or remote mutation.

Record bundle and manifest paths, SHA-256 checksums, sizes, old tip, pin tips, and bundle verification results; A6-1 must create a fresh final bundle after quiescence if the quiet-window old tip differs from the rehearsal tip.

A caught verification failure or pre-existing helper ref must leave no incomplete artifact or current-run helper ref and must name a fresh-clone-remedy; abnormal termination recovery discards the clone and retries with a fresh unfiltered clone.
